# backup-verifier

> Verify backup archives against a SHA-256 manifest, test restores safely into an empty directory and check freshness with an injected clock Python package `trysac-backup-verifier`, import name `backup_verifier`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
